title: API Token Controls
scope: Admin controls, logging and revocation for API credentials on SaaS platforms. Sourced from vendor documentation; not an audit of any tenant.

definitions.conditional: Documented, with plan, policy or endpoint conditions.
definitions.excluded: The named control explicitly does not cover this credential.
definitions.not_supported: Vendor documentation states this credential lacks the control.
definitions.unknown: No source found either way. Not a negative finding.
definitions.not_verified: No source found either way. Not a negative finding.
definitions.not_applicable: Does not apply to this credential.
definitions.limited: Documented for a narrower case only.

providers.name: Cloudflare
providers.scope_notes: Covers Cloudflare (API, Zero Trust Access, R2). All plans have API tokens and 18-month Audit Logs v2; Logpush beyond 18 months is Enterprise; Access service tokens need Cloudflare Zero Trust; R2 credentials need R2.

controls.name: Change Origin CA key
controls.what: Immediately invalidates all previously shown Origin CA key values.
controls.setting: User Profile > API Tokens > API Keys > Origin CA Key > Change

no_control.what: Changing the Origin CA key is not recorded in Audit Logs.

controls_unknown: Any account-level setting to block members from creating user API tokens or using the Global API Key.
Any account-wide policy forcing token expiry or IP filters.
Whether Super Administrators can list or revoke other members' user API tokens.
Whether dashboard SSO or Access policies are checked on API token / Global API Key requests (no explicit statement).
Exact Audit Logs v2 action names for token create/delete/roll.
Whether Origin CA keys still authenticate after the 2026-09-30 removal date.
IP restrictions for Access service tokens and for R2 S3 requests.
Cloudflare OAuth tokens (actor context 'oauth', e.g. Wrangler) were not researched.

authentication.summary: Key starting v1.0- sent in X-AUTH-USER-SERVICE-KEY for the Origin CA certificates API and Keyless SSL. Scheduled for removal on 2026-09-30.

federation.details: No doc ties it to SSO.

lifetime.summary: Valid until Change; service ends 2026-09-30 per deprecation notice

renewal.summary: Each view shows a different value; all are valid until Change.

administration.summary: Reaches every account the user can access. Changing the key is not audit logged.
administration.conditions: Verify whether keys still work after 2026-09-30.

offboard.details: The key reaches every account the user can access, so removing the user's membership removes that account from its reach.

inventory.details: No admin list of Origin CA keys found; use shows in audit logs with actor.context origin_ca_key.

inventory.api: GET /accounts/{account_id}/logs/audit?actor_context=origin_ca_key (shows users whose key was used; no key list exists)

kill.ui: User Profile > API Tokens > API Keys > Origin CA Key > Change

offboard.ui: Manage Account > Members > expand member > Revoke > Yes, revoke access (removes that account from the key's reach)

token_format.notes: Each view returns a different valid value.

log_sources.name: Audit Logs v2
log_sources.notes: actor.context = origin_ca_key for actions; key changes not logged.

anomaly_cues: Any origin_ca_key activity after the deprecation date

containment.steps: Click Change on the Origin CA key; move integrations to an API token with SSL and Certificates Edit.
containment.notes: Change immediately invalidates all prior values.

unknown: Origin CA certificate API calls not researched
